title: 心理学概論B
subtitle: Introduction to Psychology B
keywords: Development 2.Motivation and emotion 3.Individual difference 4.Social behavior 5.Mental health
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) learn the whole picture of psychology. (2) learn in areas such as development, motivation, emotion, intelligence, personality, social behavior, and mental health. (3) learn about the history of psychology and research methods. (4) acquire the ability to apply psychology.
advice: This course is required for Certified Public Psychologists. Students learn the whole picture of psychology and understand the interrelationships of psychology classes to be studied in the future. Psychology is a scientific study of "mind", a study that focuses on issues that are closely related to our daily lives.Students should understand the contents of the classess in relation to the various phenomena experienced in everyday life, and encourage them to study while being aware that they will be utilized in everyday activities. The progress and content of the classess will be adjusted in consideration of the understanding of the content of the classess.
books: Katori, H., Sugimoto, T., Torii, S., &Kawachi, J. (Eds.) (2020). Psychology, 5th revised ed. University of Tokyo Press. (ISBN: 978-4-13-012117-0)
requiredKnowledge: This course is an entrance for you to study psychology for four years. If you feel something difficult, read the textbook and reference books in the Library Center, or feel free to discuss the teacher.
